label: Demo directory listing — not a confirmed MedLink partner.
description: Independent neighbourhood pharmacies in Mumbai used as DEMO DIRECTORY LISTINGS. They are candidates, not MedLink partners: none has agreed to the use of its name, and any stock, price or availability shown for them is synthetic demo data, never their actual inventory. Entries P001 to P005 are a DISPLAY MAPPING: the app shows these names and addresses for the existing demo pharmacies of the same IDs, but the persisted pharmacy rows, local databases, inventory, events and Redis state are untouched and remain the fictional demo identities. P006 stays inactive until a database is provisioned for it and PHARMACY_P006_DATABASE_URL is set.
method: Your 18 research leads were checked first, then the earlier OpenStreetMap-based candidates. Each entry needs the shop to appear at the stated address in at least two independent sources, no sign of a chain, and a recorded provenance for every source (read directly, or only seen as a search snippet). Directories that copy OpenStreetMap do not count. Justdial returns 403 to automated reads and was not bypassed, so its facts are marked search-snippet.
locationRule: A point is 'verified' only when two independent map sources agree within 100 m. Otherwise the observed points are kept as candidates and are never used for directions or distances; Google Maps directions then use the address. Neighbourhood-centre points are never recorded.
verification: Verified here means the shop was found at this address in two independent sources and shows no sign of being a chain. It does not mean the pharmacy is a partner, is open today, or holds a valid licence.
